## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that causes existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] ⚙️ CI/CD or build pipeline improvement

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's code style standards (`ruff check .`)
- [ ] My code passes type checks (`mypy src/`)
- [ ] Existing and new unit tests pass (`pytest`)
- [ ] Documentation has been updated (both English `README.md` and Spanish `README.es.md` if applicable)
